name: Lewis

skills.name: Playtime
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Bad Guy Cleanup
skills.description: Select 1 direction around self, deal AoE Burn damage equal to 80% of attack to all enemy targets within a 3x5 frontal area and inflicts Overburn for 2 turns.

skills.name: Surprising FunBall
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Burn damage equal to 140% of attack to it. Deals fixed damage equal to 30% of attack to the target and all enemies within a 3 tile radius of it. Lewis gains 2 stacks of Tin Soldier's Order.

skills.name: Toy Carnival
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Burn damage equal to 180% of attack to it. For each Tin Soldier on the battlefield, increases damage dealt by 15% per Rank and critical rate by 5% per Rank of this attack.

skills.name: Tin Soldiers on Parade
skills.description:
At the start of the battle, Lewis gains Thermal Conduction, and consumes all points of Confectance Index to assign Tin Soldier with Rank 1 to the 2 closest allied Burn attribute Dolls (excluding self).

When allied units with Tin Soldier perform basic attacks or active attacks that deal Burn damage, Lewis commands the Tin Soldier to launch a Volley Fire at the target that took damage, and gains 3 points of Searing Flame and 1 Confectance Index. This effect can be triggered once per turn for each Tin Soldier.

When the unit with Tin Soldier assigned deals Burn damage, said unit gains 1 Merit.

At the end of the round, Lewis consumes 4 Merit to increase the Rank of the Tin Soldier, maximum once per turn.

fortification.effect:
Increases the base damage multiplier of a Volley Fire to 120% of Lewis attack.
When Tin Soldier casts Volley Fire, if the enemy target has Overburn, the Overburn effect will be triggered a number of times corresponding to their Rank.

Reduces the Confectance Cost by 2 points. 
Additional effects are added based on your highest current Rank. Higher-level effects include lower-level effects:
Rank 1: Gain Damage Up II before attacking, lasting for 2 turns.
Rank 2: This attack now ignores cover.
Rank 3: Increases the damage multiplier to 200% of your attack.

Damage multiplier is increased to 160%, fixed damage multiplier is increased to 50%. 

Tin Soldier's Order effect is modified: It no longer has stacks and no longer gets consumed by Volley Fire. Lasts for 3 rounds and increase Volley Fire damage by 50% instead.
Damage multiplier is increased to 120%. For each Burn debuff on the target, this attack deals 10% more damage, up to a maximum of 30%.
Each Tin Soldier additionally increases damage multiplier of this attack by 10% per Rank; critical damage is additionally increased by 5% per Rank.

Assigned at the start of the battle Tin Soldier has Rank 2.
Rank effect enhancements:
Rank 2: Additionally increases Critical Damage by 15%.
Rank 3: At the end of assigned doll action, unleashes Volley Fire once on the nearest enemy target. This Volley Fire provides Searing Flame but does not restore Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Idealistic Designer
keys.effect: Before using Volley Fire, inflicts Overburn to the target for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Secret of Spreading Smiles
keys.effect: Modifies the passive effect of Tin Soldiers on Parade, allowing it to apply Tin Soldiers even to non-Burn attribute Dolls. If a basic attack or active attack does not deal Burn damage, it can still trigger Volley Fire.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Protector of Innocence
keys.effect: The active skill Surprising Funball and the Toy Carnival dispels 1 buff on the target before the attack resolves.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Sunny Imagination
keys.effect: When attacking an enemy target with Overburn, damage dealt is increased by 15% and inflicts Defense Down II.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Cuteness is Justice
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, if there are Tin Soldiers on the field with a Rank of 2 and higher, the range of the active skill Surprising Funball and the Ultimate skill Toy Carnival is increased by 2 for this battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Guardian From The Cloud
keys.effect: Units with Tin Soldiers gain 2 Merit at the end of their action.

keys.name: Common Key - Mighty Miracle
keys.effect: ATK +5% / Damage dealt by Ultimate skills is increased by 10%.

keys.name: Expansion Key - Tin Soldiers Assemble
keys.effect:
After applying Tin Soldiers, if there 4 or more friendly Burn Dolls on the field, increase Rank of Tin Soldiers by 1 level.
Once the Rank reaches level 3, at the start of each Round, Lewis consumes all Merit from dolls with Tin Soldiers assigned to. For each 1 Merit consumed, Lewis' Burn damage dealt this Round is increased by 6% and Critical Damage is increased by 6%, up to a maximum of 48%.

source_notes: Extracted from GFL2 Official Release Info Compilation.xlsx with online Dandegate/gfl2.help enrichment.
